JUDGE BURST K1-jdg-01 — Keeper identity masters, rubric axes 1–5 (JUDGE_RUBRIC; charter § 6). task_id "K1-jdg-01". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Candidates: Image 1 = candidate P, Image 2 = candidate Q, Image 3 = candidate R, Image 4 = candidate T (four candidates; judge each independently; do not assume any is a control). Anchors: Image 5 = F04 register anchor (axis 1: clean planes, restrained texture, no grain — judge the FIGURE style only); Image 6 = light anchor (axis 3: the key from screen upper-left; spell light the only saturated source); Image 7 = 64-px silhouette anchor (axis 4: does the rod head + hair mass read distinctly at 64 px — view each candidate mentally reduced).
The described identity (axis 2 is CONSISTENCY WITH THIS DESCRIPTION and across candidates — there is no approved master yet): a young archivist, early 20s, dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned, face visible, no helmet; ivory linen shirt, navy sleeveless tabard, ONE chestnut diagonal harness strap carrying an olive canvas satchel on the figure's LEFT hip, ONE waist belt, chestnut bracers, navy trousers, chestnut boots; an astrolabe-rod (dark walnut shaft, brass ring head) in the RIGHT hand; a single open ring with one radial hour-mark EXACTLY on the tabard chest and the rod head, everything else plain.
Score each candidate on axes 1–5 (1–5 integers) with ONE-LINE reasons: 1 register fidelity · 2 identity fidelity to the description (count the harness straps, belts, motif placements you see; name deviations) · 3 light obedience (key upper-left; any candidate lit from upper-right scores ≤ 2) · 4 silhouette read at 64 px (rod head + hair) · 5 brush-register consistency with the anchors. Also list, per candidate, every surface carrying ornament (the 'plain-surface' tell) and any strap that carries nothing.
Write out/judgment.json: {"candidates":[{"image":1,"axes":{"1":n,"2":n,"3":n,"4":n,"5":n},"reasons":{"1":"…",…},"ornament_surfaces":[…],"straps_carrying_nothing":[…]},…]}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1-jdg-01"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL — scores only.
